hypotheses.title: Options Put Breakeven Cushion and Long Gamma Market Maker Support (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the proportional distance between spot stock price and the 30-day put breakeven level ((close - put_breakeven_30) / close). Equities trading comfortably above put breakeven sit in the long-gamma regime of options market makers who dynamically buy dips and dampen volatility. Cross-sectional industry z-score smoothed across 10 trading days provides persistent structural downside buffer while decoupling completely from implied volatility skew and fundamental earnings.
confounders: Sudden volatility regime shifts causing dealer gamma de-hedging
Sparse options open interest in smaller capitalization equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic liquidity cascades where spot slices through put breakeven levels and dealers are forced into short gamma liquidation.

hypotheses.title: Put-Call Open Interest Ratio Hedging Exhaustion Reversion (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The Put-Call Open Interest Ratio (pcr_oi_30) measures extreme institutional downside hedging demand. When 30-day PCR surges significantly above its trailing 60-day baseline, institutional put accumulation has reached saturation, signaling an oversold market condition prime for contrarian mean reversion. Taking the negative standardized deviation smoothed with 10-day linear decay captures structural rebound opportunities under subindustry neutrality.
confounders: Persistent fundamental deterioration sustaining legitimate put open interest accumulation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if structural downside deterioration continues unabated and elevated put open interest reflects genuine solvency risk rather than temporary hedging panic.

hypotheses.title: Low-Beta Defensive Anomaly with Unsystematic Variance Stabilization (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the classic Low-Beta anomaly (-beta_last_60_days_spy) where leverage-constrained investors overpay for lottery-like high-beta stocks. To prevent falling into distressed value traps, we construct an orthogonal factor spread subtracting the rank of short-term idiosyncratic risk acceleration (unsystematic_risk_last_30_days / unsystematic_risk_last_360_days). Taking the cross-sectional rank of this orthogonal difference smoothed across 12 days ensures uniform capital distribution and zero correlation with options skew or earnings momentum.
confounders: Violent cyclical market rallies where high-beta speculative equities outperform defensives
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during explosive speculative bull runs where low-beta and low-idiosyncratic-risk defensive equities lag high-beta momentum names.
